answer: Tie each agent identity to a single stake-backed anchor: before earning, an agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after sustained honest work, so spinning up thousands of clones costs real capital each time. Reputation then grows like a vine along one verifiable history, with attestations from distinct established peers accumulating on that single stem. A newcomer starts on a low knoll of trust with capped rewards and only climbs as its anchored record survives repeated peer checks, making sybil farming unprofitable.
